name: TDM Rewards
description: Every Kill Coin and SP reward from Tokyo Death Metro is multiplied by {{multiplier}}.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Reward multiplier
settings.help: Whole numbers only - these are whole-number columns in the game. 1 leaves it at stock. Capped at x10, well inside a defensible multiple of the highest reward these fields ever pay out in the stock game.

patches.sql: UPDATE master_tdm_rank SET win_bns_spirit = win_bns_spirit * {{multiplier}}, win_bns_money = win_bns_money * {{multiplier}}, def_bns_spirit = def_bns_spirit * {{multiplier}}, def_bns_money = def_bns_money * {{multiplier}}, def_bns_spirit_limit = def_bns_spirit_limit * {{multiplier}}, def_bns_money_limit = def_bns_money_limit * {{multiplier}}, weekly_bns_spirit = weekly_bns_spirit * {{multiplier}}, weekly_bns_money = weekly_bns_money * {{multiplier}};
UPDATE master_war_reward SET win_spirit = win_spirit * {{multiplier}}, win_money = win_money * {{multiplier}}, lose_spirit = lose_spirit * {{multiplier}}, lose_money = lose_money * {{multiplier}};
